articles.title: Must explore how AFMS can make meaningful contribution in domain of clinical trials: Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh called for urgent reforms within India's clinical trial framework. Singh highlighted the critical need for a robust, ethical, and efficient system for medical research, impacting national health security and the well-being of defence personnel.
